description: Candidate port of nera-data-layer post_op_no_internal_dispatch at 2b1504adc4291daaf080b2e932962b134da1a69a.

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT a.*,(SELECT f.__start FROM functions f WHERE f.__path=a.__path AND f.__start<a.__start AND f.__end>=a.__end ORDER BY f.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS owner FROM raw_assignments a

stages.name: aliases
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE alias(path,owner,name,since) AS (
            SELECT __path,__start,'literal_payload',-1 FROM functions
            UNION SELECT __path,owner,target,__start FROM assignments WHERE payload IS NOT NULL
            UNION SELECT a.__path,a.owner,a.target,a.__start FROM assignments a JOIN alias old ON old.path=a.__path AND old.owner=a.owner AND old.name=a.value AND old.since<=a.__start WHERE a.value_kind='identifier')
            SELECT path,owner,name,min(since) AS since FROM alias GROUP BY path,owner,name

stages.name: probes
stages.query: SELECT p.*,(SELECT f.__start FROM functions f WHERE f.__path=p.__path AND f.__start<p.__start AND f.__end>=p.__end ORDER BY f.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS owner FROM raw_probes p

relational.query:
SELECT p.__path AS path,p.__start AS start_byte,p.__end AS end_byte FROM probes p
        WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM aliases a WHERE a.path=p.__path AND a.owner=p.owner AND a.name=p.receiver AND a.since<=p.__start)
        UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM key_calls UNION SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM direct_membership
